summary.text: Chris Kluwe is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 72 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Gracey Van Der Mark.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former NFL player, football coach, small businessman and civil rights advocate.

paragraphs.text: Chris Kluwe said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in Seal Beach, attended local public schools and earned a bachelor's degree with a double major in history and political science from UCLA before beginning a career in the NFL.
He said that since retiring from the NFL he has worked as a coach, volunteer and writer and has volunteered at Shipley Nature Center.
Kluwe advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, he said he is running to make government work for everyone and cited the rising cost of housing, healthcare, groceries and utilities among his key messages.
